content.text: {"abstained": false, "abstention_reason": "", "answer": "The \"Ishan Uday\" Special Scholarship Scheme For North Eastern Region is a central sector scholarship scheme implemented by the University Grants Commission (UGC) under the Ministry of Education [E01]. It aims to promote higher education in the North Eastern Region by providing equal opportunities for higher studies, increasing the Gross Enrolment Ratio (GER), and focusing on professional education [E01]. The scheme offers 10,000 fresh scholarships annually for general degree courses and technical/professional courses including medical and paramedical courses [E01]. Scholarship amounts are ₹5,400 per month for general degree courses and ₹7,800 per month for technical/medical/professional/paramedical courses [E01]. Eligibility requires applicants to be domiciles of NER with parental annual income not exceeding ₹4,50,000 [E01][E03]. Applicants must have passed Class 12th and secured admission in the first year of a degree course [E03]. Scholarships are paid through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to beneficiaries' bank accounts [E01]. The scheme includes reservations for Persons with Disability and transgender candidates are eligible [E02][E03]. Scholarships are renewable during the first degree course subject to good conduct and prescribed attendance [E03].", "cited_evidence_ids": ["E01", "E02", "E03"], "claim_to_evidence": [{"claim": "The scheme is a central sector scholarship scheme implemented by the UGC under the Ministry of Education", "evidence_ids": ["E01"]}, {"claim": "It aims to promote higher education in the North Eastern Region and increase the Gross Enrolment Ratio", "evidence_ids": ["E01"]}, {"claim": "The scheme offers 10,000 fresh scholarships annually", "evidence_ids": ["E01"]}, {"claim": "Scholarship amounts are ₹5,400 per month for general degree courses and ₹7,800 per month for technical/medical/professional/paramedical courses", "evidence_ids": ["E01"]}, {"claim": "Eligibility requires applicants to be domiciles of NER with parental annual income not exceeding ₹4,50,000", "evidence_ids": ["E01", "E03"]}, {"claim": "Applicants must have passed Class 12th and secured admission in the first year of a degree course", "evidence_ids": ["E03"]}, {"claim": "Scholarships are paid through Direct Benefit Transfer to beneficiaries' bank accounts", "evidence_ids": ["E01"]}, {"claim": "Transgender candidates are eligible and reservations for Persons with Disability are included", "evidence_ids": ["E02", "E03"]}, {"claim": "Scholarships are renewable during the first degree course subject to good conduct and prescribed attendance", "evidence_ids": ["E03"]}]}
